content:
tara (People Ops): Quick heads-up — manager checklist & calibration signups are live. Please review the checklist and RSVP for a calibration slot by EOD Fri  — links below. We need completed review forms before your calibration slot. https://redwood-internal/docs/reviews/manager-checklist

kevin (Eng Manager): Thanks! Quick question: for cross-functional ICs who split time across product & infra, do we rate on primary scope or cumulative impact?

tara (People Ops): Prefer primary scope + note on cross-functional contributions. Put the 'scope split' in the comments field so calibrators can see context. Use the rubric here: https://redwood-internal/docs/reviews/rubric

ravi (Eng Manager): If a manager misses the form deadline, what's the extension policy? Some of my team had delays due to holiday.

tara (People Ops): We can grant a 72h extension in exceptional cases—please request via this form: https://redwood-internal/hr/extension-request. If multiple managers need extensions in the same team, ping me directly so we can re-slot calibration.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: review form deadline in 3 days (Fri 17:00 PT). If you haven't started, please do so now. :bell:

jenna (ML Manager): I'm double-booked for the listed calibration slots (APAC overlap). Any alternate options?

tara (People Ops): We added two overflow slots on Mon/Tue morning UTC. If you still can't make it, submit the form and upload a 5–7 min pre-read (bullet points + level rec). One of the E-Lead calibrators will review asynchronously.

alex (Hiring Ops): Also flagging that calibration outcomes feed into compensation planning. If you think someone's band needs review, include 'band recommendation' in the comments and tag me. I can pull last year's notes to help.

kevin (Eng Manager): Got it — will add scope split and tag Alex where relevant. Thanks :thumbsup:

tara (People Ops): Manager quick checklist (paste to your calendar or 1:1):
```
- Complete review form for all direct reports (fields: summary, impact examples, rubric level, calibration rec, band rec if needed)
- Add scope split notes for cross-functional ICs
- Attach 2 supporting artifacts (PR links, metrics, customer feedback)
- Run 1:1 calibration with skip-level or peer manager where possible
- RSVP to calibration slot in the signup sheet
```

tara (People Ops): If you need help drafting writeups, reply here and we'll pair you with a People Ops reviewer for 30m. We're also hosting a short reviewer office hours drop-in tomorrow 10–11 PT. Link: https://meet.redwood/po-review-hours

kevin (Eng Manager): Signing up for Tue overflow. Will DM about one tricky IC.

people-ops-bot: New RSVP recorded: kevin (Eng Manager) -> Tue overflow slot.

tara (People Ops): Thanks everyone — we're tracking RSVPs on the sheet. Ping me if anything urgent.
